 ────────────────────────────────────────
 Image Organizer CLI (iorg v4.5.15)
 ────────────────────────────────────────
Commands:          organize, list, move, clean
  iorg organize ((-s|--source) <file|dir|zip>|--source-url <https-url>) ((-r|--root) <dir>|(-a|--app) <dir>) [(-t|--tenant) <name>] [-o|--out <file>] [--json]
  iorg list <FileNamePattern> ((-r|--root) <dir>|(-a|--app) <dir>) [(-t|--tenant) <name>] [-i|--image <nr>] [--json|--quiet]
  iorg move <SourceItemId> [<TargetItemId>] ((-r|--root) <dir>|(-a|--app) <dir>) [(-t|--tenant) <name>] [(-p|--pathconv) <1|2|3|4>]
  iorg clean <ItemId> ((-r|--root) <dir>|(-a|--app) <dir>) [(-t|--tenant) <name>] [-i|--image <nr>] [--force]
  iorg clean --cache ((-r|--root) <dir>|(-a|--app) <dir>) [(-t|--tenant) <name>]
Options:
-h, --help         print out all options
-v, --version      print version info
-l, --nologo       do not display the banner
-d, --debug        enable debug output
-c, --cloud        no DefaultCloudOrder providers are configured
-s, --source       no source image directory given
--source-url       HTTPS ZIP archive source
-o, --out          receipt JSON file; --receipt is an alias
--json             write the ImageImport receipt to stdout
--exif             select '*' or comma-separated EXIF tags/patterns
--move             delete a single source file only after verified ingestion
--no-overwrite     reject differing existing media before writing
--force            perform exact-ItemId deletion
-p, --pathconv  󰎪   󰎦 CanonicalByName, 󰎩 ItemIdTree3x3, 󰎬 ItemIdTree8x2 (default), 󰎮 Flat
-n, --nameconv  󰎪   󰎦 Legacy, 󰎩 ItemTemplate, 󰎬 Structured (default)
-r, --root         exact ImageTree root; alternative to -a/--app
-a, --app          application root; Image is appended; alternative to -r/--root
-t, --tenant       subscriber/tenant below the ImageTree root; --subscriber is an alias
ImageRoot          complete destination image root
